compositionContract.environment: Use the complete painted lesson environment; do not replace it with abstract cards or gradients.
compositionContract.text: Keep the readable text area opaque and roughly half the desktop frame; preserve legibility on mobile.
compositionContract.characterAndScene: Keep the illustrated environment visible with the detail side indicated by sceneSide.
compositionContract.controls: Use cobalt primary action, white outlined secondary actions, 44px minimum controls, and a truly round microphone control for recording.
compositionContract.autoCheck: Option and fill checks use the current compact Spanish auto-check treatment; source mockup labels do not override the pilot instruction.
